about: A place's own lock names its laws as audit/<name>, never audit/<place>/<name>: the zoom is the only difference between the tree's view of a place and the place's own.
A line of a place's own lock that still names the place is counted, so the rule never regresses.

cases.name: a law named from inside the place
a law named from the tree inside the place's own lock
a withdrawn line that named the place

red was: topos's lock named its laws audit/topos/<name>, which the published lock would have carried beside the tree's audit/<name> as a second name for one law
